01

“unless they commit a clear immorality”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
unless they commit a clear immorality [al-Nisāʾ: 19], he said: "He says: unless they commit adultery and so go out to be stoned."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ [النساء: 19] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: إِلَّا أَنْ يَزْنِينَ فَيَخْرُجْنَ لِلرَّجْمِ "
Edition record 373627 · p. 663Link to report ↗
02

“if you are in doubt”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 65:4).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, on His saying:
if you are in doubt [al-Ṭalāq: 4], he says: "If you do not know whether she menstruates or does not menstruate: the one who has ceased menstruating and the one who has not yet menstruated, her waiting period is three months."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ [الطلاق: 4] يَقُولُ: «إِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا أَتَحِيضُ أَمْ لَا تَحِيضُ؟ فَالَّتِي قَعَدَتْ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ، وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَحِضْ بَعْدُ فَعِدَّتُهَا ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ»
Edition record 373628 · p. 663Link to report ↗
03

“Lodge them where you dwell out of your means”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 65:6).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
Lodge them where you dwell out of your means [al-Ṭalāq: 6], meaning: "out of your ample means."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنْتُمْ مِنْ وُجْدِكُمْ [الطلاق: 6] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنْ سَعَتِكُمْ»
Edition record 373629 · p. 663Link to report ↗
04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
and do not harm them to oppress them [al-Ṭalāq: 6], meaning: "in the lodging."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ [الطلاق: 6] ، يَعْنِي: «فِي الْمَسْكَنِ»
Edition record 373630 · p. 663Link to report ↗
04

“Let the man of wealth spend from his wealth”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 65:7).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
Let the man of wealth spend from his wealth [al-Ṭalāq: 7], meaning: "on the divorced woman when she nurses for him."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
لِيُنْفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِنْ سَعَتِهِ [الطلاق: 7] ، يَعْنِي: «عَلَى الْمُطَلَّقَةِ إِذَا أَرْضَعَتْ لَهُ»
Edition record 373631 · p. 663Link to report ↗
05

“so it tasted the ill consequence of its affair”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 65:9).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
so it tasted the ill consequence of its affair [al-Ṭalāq: 9], meaning: "the recompense of its affair."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا [الطلاق: 9] ، يَعْنِي: «جَزَاءَ أَمْرِهَا»
Edition record 373632 · p. 663Link to report ↗
06

“the command descends among them”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 65:12).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
the command descends among them [al-Ṭalāq: 12], meaning: "from the seventh heaven to the seventh earth."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ [الطلاق: 12] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنَ السَّمَاءِ السَّابِعَةِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ السَّابِعَةِ»
